snippet.title: Huntdown Mobile Teaser
snippet.description:
Huntdown Mobile Teaser for Android units.

In a neon and blood soaked dystopian future, crime rules the streets, and the police are powerless, or too corrupt to care. But there is hope, for a price. Slide into the holsters of one of 3 bounty hunters and make it rain bullets for a fistful of dollars. Alone or in co-op, Huntdown is the kind of hard boiled action shooter that has a one-liner for every kill, and satisfaction for even the itchiest of trigger fingers!

Read more here: https://huntdown.com

Made by Easy Trigger Games. Published by Coffee Stain Publishing.
